summary: Investigated whether the built prod version (served via `pnpm web:server start`, which spawns agent-server on 127.0.0.1:8787 and `vite preview` on port 4173) could be hosted through portless. Confirmed it's technically feasible with small changes (PORT fallback, scheme-aware origin allowlist, foreground `run` verb), and explained that the proxy terminates TLS so browser origins become `https://<name>.localhost`. Then looked into using a Tailscale machine-name subdomain like `https://gizmo.<machine>` instead of `.localhost`.
errors: Search query for portless proxy/route support returned mostly unrelated results (low-quality hit from appleinsider.com with score 0.25).
Scrape of portless.sh/docs, portless.sh/cli, and portless.sh/ask-ai all returned 404 'This page could not be found'.
Bash `where portless` / `portless --version` returned 'command not found', so portless is not installed in this environment and could not be empirically verified.
